note: Crisis cards. {region} is filled in with the region the card lands in. A threat card is secretly real or a false alarm (falseChance is the chance it's false); an opening card is always real.

cards.text: A radar station near {region} reports launches over the northern ice.
A patrol boat is seized in disputed water off {region}.
A watch satellite over {region} goes dark without warning.
Columns of troops are seen moving toward the border at {region}.
Sonar near {region} picks up a submarine where none should be.
A bright flash is reported over the desert beyond {region}.
Fighter jets are scrambled over {region}. Nobody says why.
A state broadcast from {region} warns of 'necessary measures'.
Two diplomats are arrested in {region} and accused of spying.
Huge military drills begin in {region}. They were not announced.
The undersea cable from {region} is cut. A trawler was seen nearby.
Long-range bombers change course toward {region}.
Photos show silo doors open across {region}.
An early-warning computer reports 200 contacts inbound over {region}.
A spy plane strays into the airspace of {region}.
Warships form a line across the harbor mouth at {region}.
A defector from {region} claims a first strike is being planned.
Smoke rises from a weapons plant in {region}. Sabotage is rumored.
A supply convoy near {region} stops answering the radio.
The direct line to the other capital goes silent during a storm over {region}.
A summit invitation arrives, to be held in neutral waters off {region}.
Ships from both blocs pull sailors from a wreck off {region}.
Floods ruin the harvest in {region}. The other bloc offers grain.
Scientists from {region} ask to share weather data across the border.
An offer comes through a third party: trade prisoners at {region}.
A sports team from {region} is invited to play across the border.
Engineers propose a second direct line, routed through {region}.
The other bloc offers to let inspectors visit its bases in {region}.
Both blocs plan to watch an eclipse from the same ridge in {region}.
An outbreak in {region} needs medicine only the other bloc makes.
